ideas.title: Investigation into Non-Profit Organizations
ideas.description: This story would investigate the increase in federal investigations into non-profit organizations and the allegations of wrongdoing that are being made.
questions: What is the extent of the misuse of funds by non-profit organizations?
How are federal investigations into non-profit organizations being conducted?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread wrongdoing by non-profit organizations and to shed light on the need for increased oversight of grant funding. By following the money and investigating the allegations of wrongdoing, this story could lead to significant reforms and increased accountability.
